items.description: Item results aligned to the prepared batch payload order.

LanguageCode3.description:
3-letter ISO 639-3 language code (e.g. `"eng"`, `"spa"`).

Construction validates that the value is exactly 3 ASCII alphabetic
characters, lowercased. Sentinel values like `"auto"` are rejected, use
[`LanguageSpec`] at boundaries where auto-detection is meaningful.

MorphosyntaxItemResultV2.description:
One morphosyntax item result returned by Python.

A tagged union, so an analysis cannot exist without the model that
produced it and an item cannot be both an analysis and an error.

repairs.description:
Every repair the worker made inside `raw_sentences`, of every
kind ([`UdRepairV2`]), in the order it made them. Empty means it
repaired nothing.

Required, with no serde default, for the reason the model is:
a default would make "this worker reports no repairs" and "this
worker does not report repairs" the same value on the wire, which
is the shape that let a rewrite live only in a log line.

oneOf.description: The item had no words, so no model ran and there is nothing to apply.
The item failed; the file it belongs to fails with this message.

MorphosyntaxModelIdentityV2.description:
The Stanza model that analyzed one morphosyntax item, as reported by the
worker that ran it.

Carried per item rather than once per worker because one batch can span
language groups, and because the process that ran the item is the only
honest witness: a capability snapshot taken from another process (inside
`transcribe`, the ASR worker) describes a different runtime.

lang.description: Language whose Stanza pipeline analyzed the item.

pipeline.description:
Which pipeline variant ran, so provenance does not hide a
retokenizing or POS-overriding path behind the plain Stanza name.

MorphosyntaxPipelineV2.description: The morphosyntax pipeline variant that analyzed an item. Closed: a new variant must be named here before a worker can report it.

PaddingValue.description: A feature value that is model padding: an angle-bracketed placeholder such as <PAD> or <UNK>.

ReportedEngineName.description: An engine identity as a worker reported it, written into cache namespaces and provenance fields byte for byte: not blank, no surrounding whitespace, and none of `|`, `;`, `]` or a line break.

UdFeatureNameRepairKindV2.description: Why a Universal Dependencies feature name a worker received from Stanza is not the name in the analysis it returned. Closed: a worker cannot report a feature name repair not named here.

UdFeatureNameRepairV2.description:
One feature name a worker respelled inside an analysis it returned.

The worker is the only witness, as for every repair: the misspelled name
is not in the analysis the server receives. Stanza's Italian model writes
`Verbform=Fin`, which every consumer of `VerbForm` would read as no form
at all; respelling it is a rewrite of what the model said, so it is
reported like one.

from_name.description: The name the model produced, verbatim (`Verbform`).

to_name.description: The UD name applied in its place (`VerbForm`).

word.description: Surface form of the word the feature belongs to.

UdFeatureRepairKindV2.description: Why a Universal Dependencies feature value a worker received from Stanza is absent from the analysis it returned. Closed: a worker cannot report a feature repair not named here.

UdFeatureRepairV2.description:
One feature value a worker removed from an analysis it returned.

The worker is the only witness, as for a relation repair: the removed value
is not in the analysis the server receives. Each removed value is its own
repair, so `Case=Nom,<PAD>` losing `<PAD>` is one repair and keeps `Nom`.

feature.description: The feature whose value it was (`Case`).

removed_value.description: The removed value, verbatim (`<PAD>`): padding, by type.

word.description: Surface form of the word the value was removed from.

UdLemmaRepairKindV2.description: Why a lemma a worker received from Stanza is not the lemma in the analysis it returned. Closed: a worker cannot report a lemma repair not named here.

UdLemmaRepairV2.description:
One lemma a worker replaced inside an analysis it returned, by the
surface form of its word.

Deserialized through [`is_punctuation_lemma`]: a reported lemma repair
whose lemma is not punctuation-only for its word is refused where the
response is read, as a feature repair of a non-padding value is. The
lemma applied is the word itself, so it is not carried twice.

from_lemma.description:
The lemma the model produced, verbatim (`...`): punctuation-only for
`word`, by admission.

word.description: Surface form of the word, which is also the lemma applied.

UdRelationRepairKindV2.description: Why one Universal Dependencies relation a worker received from Stanza is not the relation it applied. Closed: a worker cannot report a repair not named here.

UdRelationRepairV2.description:
One relation rewrite a worker made inside an analysis it returned.

Carries what it takes to attribute the rewrite as well as count it: the
word it was made on, and both relations. The worker is the only witness,
because the relation Stanza produced does not survive into the analysis it
sends: by the time the server sees the item, the repaired relation is the
only one there.

from_relation.description: The relation the model produced, verbatim.

to_relation.description:
The relation applied in its place, which the worker admits is a UD
relation before it builds this value.

word.description:
Surface form of the word whose relation was rewritten, so a reader can
find it in the transcript.

UdRepairV2.description:
One repair a worker made inside an analysis it returned: which field of
which word, and what changed.

The ONE list an analyzed item carries ([`MorphosyntaxItemResultV2::Analyzed`]):
every repair site in the worker produces a value of this type and nothing
else, so the provenance count that reads the list cannot miss a kind, and
a repair that lives in a log line only is the shape this type exists to
end. Tagged by the field repaired (`field`), with each variant's own
reason (`kind`) inside, so the tag is closed in two steps: the field here,
the reason in the field's own kind enum.

oneOf.description: A lemma was replaced by its word's surface form.
